chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Sulayman ibn Jarir, from Hariz, from Zurarah, who said:

I said to Abī 'Abd Allah عليه السلام: When should I recite the talbiyah for hajj? He said: When you depart toward Mina. Then he said: When you place Shi'b al-Dubb on your right and al-'Aqabah on your left, then recite the talbiyah for hajj.

key_terms.أُلَبِّي: to recite the talbiyah and enter into the ritual proclamation of hajj
key_terms.الْحَجِّ: the pilgrimage rite being intended here
key_terms.الْعَقَبَةَ: the pass or landmark mentioned as the opposite side indicator
key_terms.شِعْبَ الدُّبِّ: a landmark used to indicate the proper point for talbiyah
key_terms.فَلَبِّ: then recite the talbiyah at that point
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, the known sacred location toward which the pilgrim departs

ai.seo_question: When should a muhrim recite the talbiyah for hajj according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the point at which the muhrim should begin the talbiyah for hajj. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام specifies that it is to be done when setting out toward Mina, further identifying the location with clear landmarks.
